statements.impact_statement: The image replaces Debian zlib with official zlib 1.4, verified against the upstream SHA-256. This release includes upstream fix df84af25dc1942490e1d1c899a07619152a46148 for the gzwrite buffer overflow. build-zlib.sh runs upstream tests; verify_zlib.py checks the library loaded by Python, package record and compression round trips in the final image. Debian trixie has no fixed package yet; this assessment matches only the locally built version.
